about: Public images labelled for the safety-gear and workmanship checks. evaluate.py downloads them into raw/; they are never committed. scene: 'worker' photos are used to measure the PPE checks and 'wiring' photos the joint check, as the trade pack runs each check only on the criteria it fits. labels: 'fault' (the gear is missing, or a wire joint is bare) or 'ok' (the gear is worn, or the joint is taped or capped). A check not listed for an image in its scene counts as 'na': the body part or joint is not visible, or, for eye protection, nothing is being ground, cut or welded. A flag raised on an 'na' image is a false alarm.
labelledBy: One labeller, by eye, from the 1280 px images; not yet reviewed by a second person (see README.md).
